subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept client-capability-gated tool availability plus a bundled Canvas `show_widget` web-chat widget tool as the supported API and sandbox direction for this issue?
rationale: The work exposes a plugin-facing tool capability contract and renders model-authored markup in web-chat iframes, so automation cannot safely choose the product/API and security boundary alone.

options.title: Review The Linked Implementation PR
options.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox/CSP boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign The Capability API First
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject Bundled Widget Support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route widget experiments to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Implementation PR
recommendation.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox/CSP boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current proposal and implementation candidate and has the strongest current signal across the affected gateway, Canvas, and Control UI surfaces.
